build_controls.action: Bind each implementing MT to exactly one execution.module_ref; WP architecture_binding names roots, dependency directions, boundary_change and build budgets.

Check exact manifest/feature dependency closure before first focused compile. Accord/Folio exclude GUI/GPU/DB/codecs; isolated harness excludes core/native/Surreal/RocksDB; kernel bindings are opt-in separate target.
Use a stable per-owner source path, changed-file refresh with fresh mtimes and candidate commit/tree/file-count/manifest digests. Do not cold-start a new source path for every candidate.

Set explicit owner/target/toolchain/profile scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR under resolved external artifact root from the first compile. Do not inherit WP012's relative shared target path from the managed C-drive worktree. Maintain owner cleanup and parent backstop per HBR-SWARM-006; retain only explicitly approved warm compiler/source caches and pending independent-review evidence. Runtime state/governance documentation stays outside artifact outputs.

Measure focused cold/warm compile timings, peak memory, rebuilt crates, cache hits/misses and relinked binaries at stable input. Settle numeric build-budget review from exact baseline; no unmeasured speedup claims.

Reuse existing cache/tools; inspect current local settings before selecting incremental developer lane versus sccache shared-cache lane. Mozilla documents incremental Rust disables cacheability; do not blindly enable both or purge warm artifacts.

Resolve features deliberately. Resolver 3 is a candidate for the Studio workspace, not an automatic project-wide upgrade; Cargo can unify features across selected members, so heavy adapters must not leak into cheap targets.

Batch compatible focused checks once per affected package with isolated mutable prerequisites; schedule compiler concurrency from actual host/resource budgets and owned target dirs; avoid repeated broad workspace builds.

Verify exact x86_64 Windows product binaries and declared GPU/codec/font paths independently. ARM64 portable source/component proof is separate. SIMD dispatch needs scalar reference; no unconditional x86 instruction assumptions.
build_controls.rule: Exact task acceptance and cross-platform proof

build_controls.action: Required GPU or external-oracle proof fails/records dependency when absent, never silently skips to PASS. Build-only/readiness evidence cannot replace actual runtime render/edit/save/export proof.

module_hbr_contract.INT: Every observable behavior records FR/business-event, internal_diagnostics and Palmistry posture. Typed sinks/ports are proposed now, host consumers required later; WIRED only after real wire proof. Internal telemetry contains allowlisted mechanism/counter/error data, never project pixels/text.
module_hbr_contract.SWARM: Actor/request/client_session_id, task scope, deterministic command IDs, idempotency, base revisions, lease resources, conflict/cancel/recovery and per-agent view/selection. Agent navigation cannot move operator focus.
module_hbr_contract.VIS: Argus inspect/click/set_value/screenshot cover every real UI/control and re-observe exact changed result. PNG receipts bind revision/render/frame/profile/proxy/grants. Headless APIs complement actual GUI proof.
module_hbr_contract.QUIET: No unrequested foreground window, focus or keyboard capture; bounded headless work, controlled explicit GUI capture only.
module_hbr_contract.MAN: One shipped dual-audience UserManual generated/bound to canonical command/UI descriptors; actual startup/invocation, schemas, grants, recovery, primitives/APIs and diagnostic evidence. No second ModelManual.
module_hbr_contract.STOP: Current process ownership and authority boundaries; no process disruption of operator/other-session apps.
module_hbr_contract.PRIV: Default-deny Principal/AccessSpace/grants across originals, intermediate resources, linked assets, thumbnails, exports, caches, traces, model observations and revocation; recipient reauthorization on native import.
module_hbr_contract.COMPART: Owned crate DAG and measured rebuild closure; boundary/budget review where violated.
module_hbr_contract.COMPONENT: One canonical mechanic/capability owner. Configure/extend shared panel/field/swatch/menu/gizmo/time property asset before adding a sibling.
